title: Tomographic Differences in Thin Corneas Following DMEK in Fuchs Dystrophy: A Case–Control Study

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License', link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy treated by DMEK (88 eyes of 61 Caucasian patients, 2019-2022; 8 combined with phacoemulsification, 7 with repeat DMEK); inclusion required confirmed graft integration without failure at 1 year and complete graft attachment; prior refractive surgery and keratoconus excluded

groups.description: Descemet membrane endothelial keratoplasty with pre-dissected eye-bank donor tissue (7.5-8.25 mm grafts, donor ECD > 2200 cells/mm2) by three surgeons, Hospital Clinic de Barcelona; retrospective; both eyes included when eligible (27 bilateral, non-simultaneous)

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the DMEK eyes (Table 1 'At baseline (preoperative)' row 'CCT, mean (SD) µm', column 'DMEK'; footnote: baseline CCT is the preoperative measurement)
series.notes: Table 1 DMEK column at baseline (preoperative) and 'At 1 year (postoperative)'; mean (SD) in µm; Scheimpflug tomography (Pentacam HR), good-quality examinations only; n = 88 eyes (Table 1 'Number of cases')

exclusions.what: Tab1 R12 'At 3-6 months (postoperative)' CCT of the DMEK group
exclusions.reason: Time given as a range (3-6 months)

exclusions.what: Tab1 C3 'Control' group CCT (R9, R12, R15)
exclusions.reason: Unoperated control eyes (age- and sex-matched cataract surgery candidates imaged before surgery, one averaged value per patient)

exclusions.what: Tab1 rows 'CCT < 500 µm, n (%)' and C4 p-values
exclusions.reason: Counts and p-values are not admissible values

exclusions.what: Tab2 (DMEK subgroups by 1-year CCT) and Tab3 (comparisons by sex)
exclusions.reason: Tables are images without cell XML, so no cell can be cited; Tab2 subgroups are also selected by a postoperative outcome (1-year CCT)

exclusions.what: Tab4 correlations and Results-text absolute/relative CCT change and regression results
exclusions.reason: Correlation coefficients, regression estimates and text values are not admissible table values

exclusions.what: Tab1 Pentacam indices (BAD, PPIavg, ARTmax, IHA, IHD), age and sex

notes: Outcome-conditioned cohort: the DMEK group includes only eyes with confirmed graft integration without failure at 1 year, defined as improved visual symptoms, resolution of corneal edema and normal endothelial morphology, and only completely attached grafts; eyes with graft failure or incomplete follow-up data were excluded (88 of 135 FECD DMEKs). Recorded as one standard-procedure (control) group, following the dataset's handling of cohorts that exclude graft failures; follow-up values are conditional on graft success.

For the 7 eyes that needed repeat DMEK, the article does not say whether the baseline CCT precedes the first or the final graft; 8 eyes had combined phaco-DMEK; both are pooled in the Table 1 DMEK column.
88 eyes of 61 patients (27 bilateral), so eyes are not all independent.
Endothelial cell density was not measured preoperatively in the DMEK group (Methods).
